cases.why: R-CHOP response then POD; switched to salvage.
cases.evidence: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma: first-line R-CHOP for three cycles with clinical response and shrinking adenopathy, then progressive disease with new PET-avid sites before cycle 5. Discontinued R-CHOP for progression; started salvage R-ICE.

cases.why: BR response then progression; second-line planned.
cases.evidence: Mantle cell lymphoma: first-line bendamustine-rituximab with initial response after two cycles, then clear progression with rising LDH and marrow involvement at mid-treatment restaging. Stopped BR for POD; planned second-line VR-CAP.

cases.why: Induction response then morphologic relapse; reinduction.
cases.evidence: B-ALL: completed induction per protocol with day-28 MRD-negative marrow and clinical response, then morphologic relapse with 18% blasts before consolidation start. Held consolidation for relapse; planned reinduction with high-dose cytarabine-based salvage.

cases.why: Consult denies prior systemic therapy vs infusion record documents completed first-line.
cases.evidence: Allo-HCT consult: candidate is systemic-therapy naive for high-risk MDS. Same-encounter infusion record: completed four cycles first-line azacitidine with documented responses; proceed to conditioning.

cases.why: Note claims no prior lines vs outside records show two completed regimens.
cases.evidence: CAR-T referral note: no prior lines of therapy for relapsed large B-cell lymphoma. Outside records attached: completed first-line R-CHOP with CR, then second-line polatuzumab-BR with subsequent relapse; referred after two lines.
CLL/SLL: cycle 4 of first-line venetoclax-obinutuzumab with ongoing response and falling ALC. Continue current regimen; no progression or dose-limiting toxicity documented.
